issue.title: Switch reader install docs to crates.io after the first bob-obsidian publish
issue.description:
After Bryan's first manual crates.io publish of `bob-obsidian` (the go-live steps in
`docs/develop/releases/publish-to-crates-io.md`, step 7 "Update reader install
instructions"), switch the reader install docs from Git/GitHub-Release installs to the
registry: `cargo install bob-obsidian --locked` (and `cargo binstall bob-obsidian` for the
prebuilt archives). Files that currently describe the pre-registry state:
`README.md`, `docs/start/install.md`, `docs/completion.md`,
`docs/guides/install-everything.md`, `docs/guides/install-a-tagged-release.md`, and
`docs/reference/releases.md` (its "crates.io status: not yet published" row). Keep the
Git install as the "track HEAD" alternative, keep `cargo install bob-cli` warnings
(unrelated crate), and run `just docs-gen` then `just docs-check`.
Proposed by bob-cli-ac.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2) during the release-train epic
bob-cli-ac.

so it is outside the release-train epic. It is the reader-docs half of that go-live.
